verdict.rationale: Appwrite's docs name a dedicated VectorsDB product to "store embeddings and run similarity search to power AI features." They also say the managed PostgreSQL offering lets you install pgvector, so both parts of the story are first-party capabilities. The evidence is limited to short product-page lines. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the vector API, index types and distance metrics, query and filtering options, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can store embeddings and run vector similarity search for AI features

citations.quote: VectorsDB: Store embeddings and run similarity search to power AI features.
Host a managed PostgreSQL database on Appwrite. Connect with psql, Prisma, or Drizzle, install pgvector, and get backups, replicas, pooling, and PITR.
